_comment: The content-formats fixture: one stored document per JSONB
version of atom_variants.content. This is v1,
which is every version there has ever been -- the directory exists so
that the day there is a v2, the reader for v1 still has something real
to read, rather than a document written by whoever wrote the migration.
It carries every mark the model names and one it does not.
unknown mark is read, kept and rendered as plain text, and the only way
to hold that promise is a document that has one in it.
Keys beginning with an underscore are not part of the format; the reader

runs.t: from four hours to forty minutes
